response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, demonstrated leadership in AI-agent infrastructure, and deep technical breadth across cloud, data, and systems design — but lacks explicit evidence of 8+ years focused on production-grade GenAI systems, vector databases, or RAG architectures, and his resume emphasizes generalist skills over deep specialization in the required GenAI cloud domain.
strengths: Proven experience with AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks at re:cinq
Extensive cloud and distributed systems background (AWS, Kubernetes, microservices)
Strong track record of technical leadership, mentoring, and open-source contributions
concerns: No clear evidence of 8+ years dedicated to GenAI or production LLM deployments
Missing explicit experience with vector databases or RAG architecture implementation
Limited documentation of LLM optimization, multi-agent frameworks (LangGraph/CrewAI), or AI evaluation pipelines
